The '''LFA-509 system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the site of an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] upon which a [[Abandoned Separatist base|base]] was operated by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The base was later abandoned by the Confederacy and the [[Star system/Legends|star system]] left deserted.<ref name="Destruction">{{LivingForce|Heart of Evil: Destruction}}</ref> In around [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="19 BBY">[[Heart of Evil: Destruction|''Destruction'']] is set shortly before ''[[Heart of Evil: A Hero Seeks Not Vengeance|A Hero Seeks Not Vengeance]]'', a [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|Living Force]] adventure that occurs concurrently with the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]]. As the battle is dated to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'', the events of ''Destruction'' can be placed in circa 19 BBY.</ref> a [[Destruction|mission]] was undertaken by the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|military]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to the system to investigate the abandoned base.<ref name="Destruction" />
